Sneha Reddy
sneha.reddy.dev@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx04 | github.com/snehareddy | Hyderabad
SUMMARY
Frontend developer passionate about building clean, accessible user interfaces with React. Limited backend
experience; has mostly consumed third-party or mock APIs in projects.
EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science, VIT Vellore (2023-2027), CGPA: 8.5/10
SKILLS
React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Figma, Git, basic REST API consumption (Axios, fetch)
PROJECTS
Portfolio Builder for Students
•
Built a React app that generates shareable portfolio pages from a form-based input
•
Used Firebase for basic auth and Firestore for data storage (no custom backend)
Weather Dashboard
•
React app consuming a public weather REST API, styled with Tailwind CSS
CERTIFICATIONS
React - The Complete Guide (Udemy)
